merger_name: Shepparton Automotive Group - Darryl Twitt Motors dealerships in Shepparton East, Victoria
merger_description:
Jasnic Automotive Pty Ltd trading as Shepparton Automotive Group proposes to acquire the business assets of Goulburn Motor Group (Vic) Pty Ltd trading as Darryl Twitt Motors, by way of a business sale agreement (the **Acquisition**).

Shepparton Automotive Group operates a single automotive dealership located at 80 Benalla Rd, Shepparton. It supplies new vehicles as the authorised representative for Hyundai, Mitsubishi, and Suzuki, and associated vehicle servicing. Shepparton Automotive Group also supplies used vehicles and vehicle financing. Shepparton Automotive Group supplies genuine parts to consumers as part of any scheduled services performed by the dealership.

Darryl Twitt Motors operates two dealerships located at 325-329 Midland Highway, Shepparton East and 2-8 Carroll Road, Shepparton East. It supplies new vehicles as the authorised representative for Ford, Volkswagen, Audi, BYD, Geely, Land Rover, and LDV, and associated vehicle servicing. Darryl Twitt Motors also supplies used vehicles, spare parts, and vehicle financing, as well as servicing for Skoda vehicles.

Darryl Twitt Motors' Land Rover and LDV sales, service, and parts businesses are not included in the Acquisition.

events.title: Notification waiver determination published

determination_table_content.details:
In making this notification waiver determination, the Australian
Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) has considered the
information provided with the notification waiver application, and
had regard to the factors in section 51ABV(2)(b) of the Act.
Based on the information provided in the application, including the
parties’ (including their connected entities) revenues in Australia, the
ACCC considers it is likely that, if the Acquisition were put into effect,
the notification thresholds would be met.
Based on the information provided in the application, the ACCC
considers that the Acquisition may raise competition issues given:
a. there is horizontal overlap between Shepparton Automotive
Group and Darryl Twitt Motors in the supply of new and
used cars in the Shepparton region of VIC, and the extent of
inter-brand competition between the parties is unclear
b. the parties’ combined share of supply of new cars in the
Shepparton region may be significant
c. the extent to which the merged entity would be likely to face
intra- and inter-brand competition from alternative
dealerships in the Shepparton region and the surrounding
areas is uncertain.
The ACCC considers that the Acquisition warrants consideration
through the notification process, including via consultation with third
parties.
Given the above, the ACCC has determined not to make the
notification waiver determination applied for.
The ACCC considers that the determination is consistent with the
object of the Act and the interests of consumers in promoting
competition.
For more information about the ACCC’s approach to considering
notification waiver applications and to assessing competition
effects more generally, see the ACCC’s guidance on notification
waivers and merger assessment guidelines.
